info.name: Adobe Campaign Classic Custom Resources Real-Time Events API
Adobe Campaign Push a Real-time Transactional Event

items.docs: Pushes a single real-time event to the Message Center execution instance for transactional message processing. The event must include the event type and recipient context data. Supports email, SMS, and push notification channels. SOAP Action: nms:rtEvent#PushEvent

info.name: Adobe Campaign Push Batch Real-time Events

items.docs: Pushes a batch of real-time events to the Message Center execution instance for transactional message processing. More efficient than individual PushEvent calls when sending multiple events. SOAP Action: nms:batchEvent#PushEvents
